# PaySplitr

> PaySplitr is a secure and user-friendly platform for distributing payment records to task-based distributors. Designed for organizations handling recurring fieldwork, PaySplitr helps manage task assignments, monitor performance, and automate payouts.

## Blog Posts

- [Launching PaySplitr](https://paysplitr.com/blog/launch): Learn how PaySplitr streamlines the task-payment lifecycle for organizations.
- [Building a Notification System](https://paysplitr.com/blog/notifications): How we built a dual notification system with email and in-app alerts.
- [Task Completion Insights](https://paysplitr.com/blog/task-completion): A deep dive into how we track and visualize distributor task completion metrics.
